summary: DouYu International Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026. Total net revenues were RMB981.1 million (US$144.6 million) versus RMB1,053.9 million a year earlier; gross profit rose to RMB159.0 million with a 16.2% margin, while the company posted an operating loss of RMB21.3 million and a net loss of RMB72.4 million. MAUs reached 45.4 million, up 2.6% sequentially. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transactional terms, advisors, or deal mechanics are stated.
